  <bpmn:process id="playground_demo" name="演示审批流" isExecutable="true" flowduet:defaultFormKey="form_1">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="开始">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_1" name="经理审批" flowable:assignee="${manager}">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="cc_1" name="抄送法务备案" flowable:delegateExpression="${flowduetCcTask}" flowable:ccTo="张三,李四">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="fork1" name="金额判断" default="fa">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fb</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="a_node" name="总监审批" flowable:assignee="${director}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fa</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa_j</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pfork" name="并行开始">
      <bpmn:incoming>fb</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_fin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_legal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pjoin" name="并行结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fin_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>legal_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pj_j1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="fin_node" name="财务复核" flowable:assignee="${finance}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_fin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fin_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="legal_node" name="法务复核" flowable:assignee="${legal}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_legal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>legal_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="join1" name="汇聚">
      <bpmn:incoming>pj_j1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>fa_j</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fj</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="approval_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="cc_1" targetRef="fork1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa" name="常规审批" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="a_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fb" name="大额复核" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="pfork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount > 1000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_fin" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="fin_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_legal" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="legal_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fin_pj" sourceRef="fin_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="legal_pj" sourceRef="legal_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pj_j1" sourceRef="pjoin" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa_j" sourceRef="a_node" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fj" sourceRef="join1" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_mi" name="合同会签" flowable:assignee="${assignee}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics flowable:collection="approvers" flowable:elementVariable="assignee">
        <bpmn:completionCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nrOfCompletedInstances == nrOfInstances}</bpmn:completionCondition>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_in_1" sourceRef="approval_1" targetRef="approval_mi" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_out_1" sourceRef="approval_mi" targetRef="cc_1" />

      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pjoin" name="并行结束">

      <bpmn:outgoing>legal_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="join1" name="汇聚">
      <bpmn:incoming>pj_j1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>fa_j</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fj</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="approval_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="cc_1" targetRef="fork1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa" name="常规审批" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="a_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fb" name="大额复核" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="pfork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount > 1000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_fin" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="fin_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_legal" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="legal_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fin_pj" sourceRef="fin_node" targetRef="pjoin" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pj_j1" sourceRef="pjoin" targetRef="join1" />

{"format": "flowduet.design", "version": 1, "engine": "flowable", "xml": "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:flowduet="urn:flowduet:bpmn" xmlns:flowable="http://flowable.org/bpmn" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="playground_demo_defs" targetNamespace="http://flowduet.dev/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="playground_demo" name="演示审批流" isExecutable="true" flowduet:defaultFormKey="form_1">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="开始">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_1" name="经理审批" flowable:assignee="${manager}">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:scriptTask id="cc_1" name="抄送法务备案" flowable:delegateExpression="${flowduetCcTask}" flowable:ccTo="张三,李四">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:scriptTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="fork1" name="金额判断" default="fa">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fb</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="a_node" name="总监审批" flowable:assignee="${director}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fa</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa_j</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pfork" name="并行开始">
      <bpmn:incoming>fb</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_fin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_legal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pjoin" name="并行结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fin_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>legal_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pj_j1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="fin_node" name="财务复核" flowable:assignee="${finance}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_fin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fin_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="legal_node" name="法务复核" flowable:assignee="${legal}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_legal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>legal_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="join1" name="汇聚">
      <bpmn:incoming>pj_j1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>fa_j</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fj</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="approval_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="cc_1" targetRef="fork1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa" name="常规审批" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="a_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fb" name="大额复核" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="pfork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount > 1000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_fin" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="fin_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_legal" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="legal_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fin_pj" sourceRef="fin_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="legal_pj" sourceRef="legal_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pj_j1" sourceRef="pjoin" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa_j" sourceRef="a_node" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fj" sourceRef="join1" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_mi" name="合同会签" flowable:assignee="${assignee}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics flowable:collection="approvers" flowable:elementVariable="assignee">
        <bpmn:completionCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nrOfCompletedInstances == nrOfInstances}</bpmn:completionCondition>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_in_1" sourceRef="approval_1" targetRef="approval_mi" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_out_1" sourceRef="approval_mi" targetRef="cc_1" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="playground_demo" name="演示审批流" isExecutable="true" flowduet:defaultFormKey="form_1">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="开始">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_1" name="经理审批" flowable:assignee="${manager}">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="cc_1" name="抄送法务备案" flowable:delegateExpression="${flowduetCcTask}" flowable:ccTo="张三,李四">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="fork1" name="金额判断" default="fa">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fb</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="a_node" name="总监审批" flowable:assignee="${director}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fa</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa_j</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pfork" name="并行开始">
      <bpmn:incoming>fb</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_fin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_legal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pjoin" name="并行结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fin_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>legal_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pj_j1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="fin_node" name="财务复核" flowable:assignee="${finance}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_fin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fin_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="legal_node" name="法务复核" flowable:assignee="${legal}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_legal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>legal_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="join1" name="汇聚">
      <bpmn:incoming>pj_j1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>fa_j</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fj</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="approval_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="cc_1" targetRef="fork1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa" name="常规审批" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="a_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fb" name="大额复核" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="pfork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount > 1000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_fin" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="fin_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_legal" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="legal_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fin_pj" sourceRef="fin_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="legal_pj" sourceRef="legal_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pj_j1" sourceRef="pjoin" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa_j" sourceRef="a_node" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fj" sourceRef="join1" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_mi" name="合同会签" flowable:assignee="${assignee}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics flowable:collection="approvers" flowable:elementVariable="assignee">
        <bpmn:completionCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nrOfCompletedInstances == nrOfInstances}</bpmn:completionCondition>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_in_1" sourceRef="approval_1" targetRef="approval_mi" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_out_1" sourceRef="approval_mi" targetRef="cc_1" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="playground_demo" name="演示审批流" isExecutable="true" flowduet:defaultFormKey="form_1">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="开始">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_1" name="经理审批" flowable:assignee="${manager}">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="cc_1" name="抄送法务备案" flowable:delegateExpression="${flowduetCcTask}" flowable:ccTo="张三,李四">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="fork1" name="金额判断" default="fa">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fb</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="a_node" name="总监审批" flowable:assignee="${director}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fa</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa_j</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pfork" name="并行开始">
      <bpmn:incoming>fb</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_fin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_legal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pjoin" name="并行结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fin_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>legal_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pj_j1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="fin_node" name="财务复核" flowable:assignee="${finance}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_fin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fin_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="legal_node" name="法务复核" flowable:assignee="${legal}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_legal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>legal_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="join1" name="汇聚">
      <bpmn:incoming>pj_j1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>fa_j</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fj</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="approval_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="cc_1" targetRef="fork1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa" name="常规审批" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="a_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fb" name="大额复核" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="pfork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount > 1000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_fin" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="fin_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_legal" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="legal_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fin_pj" sourceRef="fin_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="legal_pj" sourceRef="legal_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pj_j1" sourceRef="pjoin" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa_j" sourceRef="a_node" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fj" sourceRef="join1" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_mi" name="合同会签" flowable:assignee="${assignee}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics flowable:collection="approvers" flowable:elementVariable="assignee">
        <bpmn:completionCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nrOfCompletedInstances == nrOfInstances}</bpmn:completionCondition>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_in_1" sourceRef="approval_1" targetRef="approval_mi" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_out_1" sourceRef="approval_mi" targetRef="cc_1" />

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:flowduet="urn:flowduet:bpmn" xmlns:flowable="http://flowable.org/bpmn" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="playground_demo_defs" targetNamespace="http://flowduet.dev/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="playground_demo" name="演示审批流" isExecutable="true" flowduet:defaultFormKey="form_1">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="开始">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_1" name="经理审批" flowable:assignee="${manager}">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="cc_1" name="抄送法务备案" flowable:delegateExpression="${flowduetCcTask}" flowable:ccTo="张三,李四">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="fork1" name="金额判断" default="fa">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fb</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="a_node" name="总监审批" flowable:assignee="${director}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fa</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fa_j</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pfork" name="并行开始">
      <bpmn:incoming>fb</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_fin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fp_legal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="pjoin" name="并行结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fin_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>legal_pj</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>pj_j1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="fin_node" name="财务复核" flowable:assignee="${finance}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_fin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fin_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="legal_node" name="法务复核" flowable:assignee="${legal}">
      <bpmn:incoming>fp_legal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>legal_pj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="join1" name="汇聚">
      <bpmn:incoming>pj_j1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>fa_j</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>fj</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="结束">
      <bpmn:incoming>fj</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="approval_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="cc_1" targetRef="fork1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa" name="常规审批" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="a_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fb" name="大额复核" sourceRef="fork1" targetRef="pfork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amount > 1000}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_fin" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="fin_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fp_legal" sourceRef="pfork" targetRef="legal_node" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fin_pj" sourceRef="fin_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="legal_pj" sourceRef="legal_node" targetRef="pjoin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pj_j1" sourceRef="pjoin" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fa_j" sourceRef="a_node" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="fj" sourceRef="join1" targetRef="end" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="approval_mi" name="合同会签" flowable:assignee="${assignee}" flowable:formKey="form_2">
      <bpmn:incoming>flow_conv_in_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>flow_conv_out_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics flowable:collection="approvers" flowable:elementVariable="assignee">
        <bpmn:completionCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nrOfCompletedInstances == nrOfInstances}</bpmn:completionCondition>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_in_1" sourceRef="approval_1" targetRef="approval_mi" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="flow_conv_out_1" sourceRef="approval_mi" targetRef="cc_1" />
  </bpmn:process>
